keySentence: Mole decided to go up outside.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mole came out of the ground. Everything was green and beautiful. He was so happy and excited. Mole decided to go up outside.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mole stepped into the sunlight for the very first time. Green grass stretched out everywhere around him. Flowers bloomed in every color he could imagine. Mole decided to go up outside and never go back. He walked and walked, feeling the warm breeze. Everything was new and wonderful to his eyes.
facts.Word cards: Mole = 두더지 / never = 한 번도 ~없이 / before = 전에 / world = 세상
